resources.string: Send app usage, unlocks and browser visits to your own receiver. Automatic sync runs about every 15 minutes when connected; Android may delay background work. Failed deliveries are retried. Your receiver must support the ActivityWatch webhook format.
Enter a receiver token of at least 32 characters
For Via, choose Settings → General → Toolbars settings → URL field content → URL. Title-only display does not expose the webpage address.
Importing usage history… the dashboard may be incomplete until it finishes.
Allows ActivityWatch to read the URL and title from your browser.

To track your web browsing activity, ActivityWatch uses Android's Accessibility API to read the URL and page title from your browser while you browse.

This data is stored on your device. If you enable synchronization, it is also sent to the destination you configure. It is never sent to the ActivityWatch developers.

If you agree, enable ActivityWatch under Accessibility settings on the next screen. This is optional — the rest of the app works without it.
